claim_one_line: THE SPECIALIST BAR'S LITERATURE HALF RETRIEVED (WebSearch returned to this bench today; on the first search against SEAM-A, B707's THIRD named-but-never-run bridge test -- 'Lee x B680/B683' -- turned out to have its object in hand). THE PAPER (Dong Uk Lee, arXiv:2502.11950, 17 Feb 2025; already cited by B707 by number): for ANY finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifold a MIXED TATE MOTIVE over the INVARIANT TRACE FIELD is constructed whose BEILINSON REGULATOR equals the PSL2(C) Chern-Simons invariant = the complex volume, up to constant; for single-torus-boundary manifolds its Hodge realization is a quotient of the MHS on the PATH TORSOR between the geometric point (the complete hyperbolic structure) and a TANGENTIAL BASE POINT AT AN IDEAL POINT. THREE RETRIEVED FACTS B707 DID NOT HAVE: (1) the appendix is titled 'Confirmation of Conj. for knot complements 4_1' -- OUR OBJECT IS THE VERIFIED CASE; (2) the tangential base point is NOT CANONICAL -- the text takes 'any tangent vector satisfying the condition', a choice among admissible vectors, not a derived datum; (3) the paper's own caveat that for non-rational curves 'the motivic path torsor is a hypothetical object'. THE STRUCTURAL CONVERGENCE, SHARP: the paper's object is a path torsor between the geometric point and a MARKING AT THE IDEAL POINT -- structurally the shape of our missing W0 (the hyperbolic structure is given; a marking at the cusp must be ADDED) -- and the literature's state of the art supplies that marking BY CHOICE, NOT BY DERIVATION: an outside, independent instance of the shape our record proved from the inside (B1163's orientation theorem, B760/B1183's no-self-closure, the free-orbit theorem). OUR HALF, COMPUTED FRESH HERE at 40 dps: Vol(m004) = 2.029883212819307250042405108549 = (3sqrt3/2)L(chi_-3,2) = 9 sqrt3 zeta_K(2)/pi^2, and the complex volume 2R(e^{i pi/3}) = pi^2/6 + i Vol to 2.3e-41 (the CS = 0 statement) -- so the quantity Lee's motive realizes motivically over K = Q(sqrt-3) is exactly the number the record already holds arithmetically (B680/B1117/B1088), and B707's test-3 question is answered YES AT THE LEVEL OF THE NUMBER ON OUR SIDE (verified here), with the motivic identification CITED not verified. WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: it does not supply W0 -- it CHOOSES a basepoint, and a construction that chooses is not one that derives; nothing here weakens the program's negatives. FENCES (E37 applied to myself): I read the ABSTRACT and an AUTOMATED SUMMARY of the arXiv HTML -- not the mathematics; the motive's construction, the regulator computation, and the appendix's content are CITED/UNVERIFIED, and the identification 'tangential base point ~ W0' is a HYPOTHESIS (a shape-match between an abstract and our record), explicitly not a theorem. THE NAMED VERIFICATION STEP: read section 7.4 and Appendix A properly and answer (a) is the admissible tangent-vector set a TORSOR and under what group -- a Z/2 or V4 would be direct contact with B1174/B1182's legs; (b) does the 4_1 confirmation use the CS=0/amphichirality degeneracy B1195/GC-21 just made exact on our side; (c) does the invariant-trace-field statement specialize to Q(sqrt-3) in the form the seam needs. This is the first NEEDS-SPECIALIST bar item whose literature half is IN HAND rather than absent; the bar's shape is unchanged, its reading list is not. Gate 5 clean.
